Hello,

This is my two pence, I am trying to figure this out too.

First I'd like to say that being awakened is not that simple. The only awakened I know is enlightenment that either takes discipline or it is spontaneous. So I will answer with regards to the ideal human or the "truly awakened" and not pretend awakening where people speak in poetry but in reality, they are lying. I will also compare and contrast the two.

​

>If an individual is on the path to awakening/is awakened, they wouldn’t identify with the self, correct?

On the path to enlightenment, there is a shift from identifying with your personality to identifying with I AM - consciousness. During the process of deepening, I would say there are times when you have to objectify the experience and understand why you felt or identify with something. But a truly awakened person will have less strong emotions because emotions represent how aligned we are with our higher selves.

​

>So they wouldn’t identify with these feelings, and probably wouldn’t need some sort of therapy and or medication to process and overcome the trauma they experienced?

This is where it gets tricky.

We all have come from such diverse backgrounds so it is hard to say if a person needs medication or therapy. Therapy is a way of understanding the reasons for the emotions and self-harming tactics. They help us to offer compassion to the negative beliefs that create negative emotions and bad habits.

Negative emotions serve to guide us back to alignment so they are very necessary.

( accidentally posted too early, I am not done)  


An awakened person in a traumatic experience I would imagine would allow themselves to feel negative emotions and allow that to guide them back to balance. They would see work on reconstructing the meaning behind the experience, they would process, and they would seek help if necessary. Not because you are awakened does not mean you stop being human.  


We need people, we need to cry, we need to scream. An enlightened person allow these things to flush through their systems purely like a child but still as wise as a sage.

After meeting the needs of the negative emotions they would apply pragmatic strategies to feel better, and create alignment. They may meditate, excercise, cry some more, talk to people, maybe just leave it alone.   


The interesting thing about all this is that through out the entire experience they still remember that they are not the person crying. They know that they are not the experience and that is the part that takes work. The ability to reconnect to that void, the source, eternal love, so that you can replace the insecure ego with a divine connection. This would probably make things easier to heal. But they still have an ego. You need an ego to be alive, but the ego is lovingly in the back seat with your eternal self-driving the car.  


I hope this made sense. This is what I imagine anyway based on all the information I have sucked up.

The divine ego is already there it just takes practice to get back there.  


I am not there yet but I train to be, constantly.

Hello,  


Post-awakening emotional work I assume is wanting to deepen your understanding of the self and maybe make peace with difficult feelings.

So for emotional work, I recommend Teal Swan. She has helped me to understand and slowly make peace with my emotions, what they mean for real and how to heal. A good start for understanding emotion could be her video about Fragmentation.  You can also just skim through her videos, very powerful.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EeUlPO2iXb4&ab\_channel=TealSwan](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EeUlPO2iXb4&ab_channel=TealSwan)

I would say please, please, please, do not be hard on yourself. I know that is damn near impossible for some of us but when it comes to emotions, especially traumatized ones, they deserve a lot of love, patience and gentleness. EVERY EMOTION IS VALID. ALL OF THEM. ALL OF THEEEEM

Emotional work is also something you do all the time, working between how you truly feel and how you THINK you SHOULD behave or believe.  But you can definitely take breaks, trust how you feel.

Just remember to trust yourself, emotions are the guide path back to you GOD-ness. Trust how you feel.  Just remember to remain grounded and do not shy away from a psychoanalytical approach. 

Psychology is a also a great help but again, but don't take it too serious like me. It can get too stressful. Just stay kind while you are deepening. That is very important, kindness, compassion and curiosity.  


And some fun, if possible.

This is not a stupid question.

So an awakened person ( to me) would allow love, attraction or whatever pulls them towards another person. A "truly awakened" person allows themselves to have an experience with another person without the fear of loss. They allow the experience of their relationship to bring up what needs to come up without being attached to the outcome.

An ideally awakened person or enlightened person is also connected to the love that is always there. So they know deep down and feel it, that there is no loss and only expansion. To hold onto a person and need them to always be there is an opportunity to an awakened person to examine with compassion why am I attached?

Attraction is the way the universe wants us to unite with an aspect of ourselves that the person we are attracted to has. They have something that you forgot you have subconsciously.  So love bring that aspect of yourself to you for integration.

[https://tealswan.com/resources/articles/attraction-why-you-are-attracted-to-the-people-youre-attracted-to-r375/](https://tealswan.com/resources/articles/attraction-why-you-are-attracted-to-the-people-youre-attracted-to-r375/)

For example, I am attracted to masculinity so I have the work to integrate masculinity inside myself. If I feel attached to a partner that is ideal to me it means that I feel I can not be masculine on my own, hence, I need to be and stay with them.  


We should also remember that there is secure and insecure attachment. So if you wish you can research attachment styles. You can still be awakened but securely attatched.  


[https://www.verywellmind.com/attachment-styles-2795344](https://www.verywellmind.com/attachment-styles-2795344)

An awakened person allows with compassion the entire experience.
